parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to start the query. Leave this parameter empty to start the query from the beginning.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The list of resource IDs. The number of elements in the array N must be 1.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to \`cluster\`.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags. The number of elements in the array N can be from 1 to 20.
